g.data-exception-reason: Index native single-height dot rows and a filled spoon dot field are explicit alternatives inside the shared master, sampled from its continuous semantic geometry.1.2mm graphic circles follow the cup and bowl boundary centrelines; this changes outer reach versus2mm swell strokes by0.4mm. Spoon perimeter circles extend0.6mm outside the continuous silhouette; this deliberate sampling allowance retains a traceable contour. No other profile geometry changes.

g.data-design-reason: All continuous geometry is shared unchanged. Cup and bowl vessel paths are referenced once for a lower filled area and once for their higher2mm outline, allowing boundary tracing and object-area exploration. Cup handle remains an open high outline with unraised aperture. Spoon retains one high solid silhouette; no second level adds necessary information. These explicit per-concept decisions do not derive height automatically from generic semantic tags.
